author: throwaway_ledger
title: AITA for charging my sister rent after she moved into my spare room?
text: My sister lost her job in March and asked to stay with me for a few weeks. I said yes. Those few weeks turned into five months. She does not pay for groceries, she does not clean, and she has been sleeping until noon every day while I leave for work at six. Last week I told her that from the first of the month she owes me four hundred dollars a month, which is less than half of what the room would rent for. She called me cruel and called our mother, who told me family does not charge family. I said family also does not freeload for five months. My mother has not spoken to me since. I do feel guilty about the timing, because she is still job hunting. But I am forty one years old and I cannot be somebody's landlord and their parent at the same time. So, am I the asshole?
